title: Quick-Fix Korean Chicken Bowl
description: A quick and delicious Korean-inspired dish featuring sous-vide chicken and a spicy sauce. This recipe is perfect for a weeknight meal or a Buddhist temple-friendly gathering.
instructions: Season the chicken breast with salt and black pepper.
Seal the chicken in a sous vide bag with the garlic and a splash of sesame oil.
Cook the chicken in a water bath at 145°F for 1 hour.
While the chicken is cooking, whisk together the chili sauce, gochujang, and brown sugar in a small bowl.
Once the chicken is cooked, remove it from the bag and slice it into thin strips.
Heat a small amount of oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced chicken to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes, until browned.
Stir in the chili sauce mixture and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Serve the chicken over cooked rice with green onions on top.
